lines.text: Boaz sits at the gate with ten elders and tells the nearer kinsman-redeemer that Naomi is selling Elimelech's land, and he says he will redeem it.
When Boaz says the buyer must also acquire Ruth, the man gives up his right and removes his sandal.
Boaz tells the elders he is buying from Naomi, and the people bless him to be like Rachel and Sarah.
Boaz takes Ruth as his wife, the LORD enables her to conceive, and Naomi becomes nurse to the son.
Boaz and Ruth name the baby Obed, who becomes the father of Jesse, the father of David.

wrong_details.wrong: Boaz and Ruth name the baby
